risks.title: False-positive volume on developer machines
risks.summary: Unsigned binaries with LaunchAgents are common and legitimate on developer machines, and the Apple-only allowlist does not recognize third-party Developer-ID or self-built tools, so they surface as actionable findings.
mitigations: Monitor tier absorbs low-signal items (not shown in detail)
User allowlist (~/.config/counterspy/allowlist.txt) to vet known-good tools
Primary open question for the ABORT release gate

risks.title: Signed / Gatekeeper-accepted malware not re-adjudicated
risks.summary: CounterSpy trusts the Gatekeeper (spctl) verdict; a Developer-ID-signed, Gatekeeper-accepted supply-chain implant is treated as trusted and will not be flagged on signature grounds alone.
mitigations: Correlation + tripwires can still flag it on behavior (persistence/listener/TCC)
Documented as an explicit non-goal in the threat model
